topics.title: Introducing printing - fmt.Print()
topics.description: Study concepts and solve targeted engineering problems for Introducing printing - fmt.Print().

pages.title: Introduction
pages.content:
## Introduction

This lesson focuses on **Introducing printing - fmt.Print()**.

Use the example below to practice the syntax and behavior of this Go concept.

callout.title: Key takeaway
callout.text: Introducing printing - fmt.Print(): focus on the Go syntax and runtime behavior demonstrated in this lesson.

codeCard.code:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
    a, b := 7, 19
    fmt.Print(a + b)
    fmt.Print(" ")
    fmt.Print(a * b)
}

pages.content:
What is the difference between 

```go

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Print(12)
        fmt.Print(11)
}

```
and
```go
package main
import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Print(12)

        fmt.Print(11)
}
```
